rule: One calm launch gate decides whether buyer traffic, supplier onboarding, paid listing revenue, and backend routing can move forward.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, or commission handling in phase one; suppliers keep rental payment direct and Heavyster earns listing SaaS revenue.

gates.name: Buyer traffic
gates.reason: Search has proof, availability, and direct enquiry path.

gates.name: Supplier onboarding
gates.reason: Supplier account, first listing, proof, and lead route are visible.

gates.name: Paid listing
gates.reason: USD 9/month or USD 99/year per active listing stays the first revenue model.

gates.name: Backend route
gates.reason: Next build should turn the scaffold into accounts, listings, proof, and direct lead records.
